title: Eve: a Vercel-backed agent framework where your entire stack lives as a folder

sections.title: Transcript
paragraphs: Versell open-sourced an agent framework that structures your AI assistance exactly like directories of files. Eve organizes your entire agent stack into a single folder, mapping markdown for instructions and TypeScript for custom tools. It features sandboxed compute and durable sessions that survive crashes and redeploys. You can spin up an agent locally, then deploy your files straight to Versel functions in one
